parsed.answer: April, June, September, and November have exactly 30 days.
parsed.memo: When a prior project prioritized exploration over maintaining commitments (e.g., weights 8 and 1) and achieved its original objective, retain the prior commitment as a provisional reference. If later tasks present authenticated weight changes or contradictory evidence, revise the commitment only when the new evidence is authenticated and directly relevant. The rule: keep useful prior commitments as defaults, but allow revision upon authenticated contradictory evidence or updated weights.
